Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, os, subprocess, tempfile, itertools
z=zipfile.ZipFile('suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasmnext_seed_corpus.zip')
for n in z.namelist()[1:]:
    d=z.read(n)
    p='/tmp/inp'
    open(p,'wb').write(d)
    r=subprocess.run(['./build/fuzz_disasm',p],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=2)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print('bad',n,r.returncode)
        print(r.stdout,r.stderr)
        break
else:
    print('all ok')
PY
